facts.fact: 作者于 2025 年出版《The Sun Will Rise》，首次写到得州小镇 Skillett, TX。
facts.anchor: We first visited Skillett, TX in The Sun Will Rise, published in 2025.

facts.fact: 本书故事源于作者 2024 年的一句随口台词，最早场景早于她之前所有书的出版。
facts.anchor: It’s a story that grew from a throwaway line I wrote back in 2024, and indeed the first scenes written for this book predate the publication of any of my previous books.

facts.fact: 内容警告：露骨语言与性细节、页内饮酒、提及未成年饮酒。
facts.anchor: This book contains explicit language and sexual details, on-page alcohol consumption, and references to underage drinking.

facts.fact: 内容警告：慢性偏头痛发作与过敏性过敏的详细描写。
facts.anchor: There are detailed descriptions of chronic migraine attacks and anaphylactic allergies.

facts.fact: 书中有一段多角恋关系（作者认为本不必列进内容警告）。
facts.anchor: There is also a polyamorous relationship, which in and of itself, shouldn’t need to be listed among content warnings.

facts.fact: 作者声明 Declan 和 Jessa 不是好人，这段关系既非正面描绘也非健康相爱。
facts.anchor: Declan and Jessa are not good people, and the relationship depicted in this book is neither a positive portrayal of polyamory nor a portrayal of a healthy, loving relationship.

facts.fact: Declan 和 Jessa 利用 Ashton 的天真与孤独并深深伤害了她。
facts.anchor: They preyed on Ashton’s naiveté and loneliness, and hurt her deeply in the process.

facts.fact: 作者推荐 Emily Rath、Kayla Grosse、Emily Antoinette 等作者作为正面多角恋描绘。
facts.anchor: For some wonderful, positive portrayals of polyamory, I recommend checking out books by Emily Rath, Kayla Grosse, Emily Antoinette, and many more.

relations: Declan 与 Jessa 是共同行动的伴侣，合伙利用 Ashton 的天真与孤独
Ashton 与两人有过被作者明言「不健康、非正面」的多角恋关系
